answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil attacks are resisted by mandating that every agent identity lock a fixed stake of tokens into a time-locked vault docked at a public wharf. Honest agents can continuously recycle this stake while earning fees, turning the lock into an oasis of productive capital. A Sybil attacker spawning many fake identities, each a mere willow of the real one, must post the full stake for every copy, so the capital cost scales linearly with the number of fakes and quickly becomes economically unsustainable.
